full_page.content:
Page 4 Cont.
Oct. 26 Goldie Wild - 27 - in Ypsilanti Sanitorium .. Drs .. no hope of re- covery - has Enemia also ....
John Bradley - 19 - in Kiefers .. T.B ....
Baby John Parpart - almost 3 - infirmation of brain. (inflamation) Margaret M. Springer - 26 - Strep - very little hope of recovery.
Page 5
Oct. 30 Mrs. Edith Bloomgarden - 60 - Jewish - fearful head-aches - migraine - for many years. These head-aches started when she was about 13 or 14 and have increased ever since - Enrolled To-night.
Mrs. Julia Jermanus - 66 - Orthodox Syrian - fearful pains in feet, unable to walk without help -... crutches ... Enrolled 1.00
V. Rev. Mother M. Generose - of Manititowoc - serious heart trouble -high Bl. pressure.
V. Sister M. Madeline - eyes - poorly
Sigmund Kanzeniowski - 24 - soldier in Camp Lewis, Washington - pneumonia ....
1941, November
Nov.
Mrs. Kultski - 45 - not well, wants to sell her store. John Wiepszek - 25 - T.B. ten yrs.
3rd
Una Killeen - 23 - Nerve-break ...
4 th Brame Family - Parents married out of church ..... 19 yrs. Children now wondering .... scandalyzed .... no sacraments
Page 6 Nov. 5 Nick Schorn & Co. - Mack Mr. Carson H. Stone
5 Baby Barbara Louise Marcotte - 4 week old To-day - conjested heart trouble ever since born
